description: This header defines template functions for transforming and evaluating std::optional objects, inspired by monadic patterns.

methods.name: transform_optional
methods.description: Transforms an std::optional into another std::optional of possibly a different type by applying a function if the optional has a value.

methods.name: evaluate_or
methods.description: Applies a function to the value of an std::optional or returns a default value if the optional is empty.
